description:
Does this job need a robot at all? Rule-based verdict from the Ladder Test (the same rules as whirrwork.com/tools/robot-or-ladder/): answer up to 6 questions yes / no / unsure and get ladder, robot, both or tossup, the reasons on each side with their points, what to find out first, and (with job) the sourced price and provider counts for that job. No numbers except our own counts; nothing is stored. Questions: ladder = could a competent person with a ladder do it in an afternoon?; risk = is it dangerous for a person (height, confined space, live wires)?; scale = is it big (many hectares, a whole facade, a warehouse)?; repeat = will it repeat often (weekly, daily)?; data = do you need measurements or records (maps, thermal, logs)?; hands = does it need hands-on fixing (repair, not just looking)?
Examples: {"ladder":"yes","risk":"no","scale":"no","repeat":"no"}; {"ladder":"no","risk":"yes","scale":"yes","data":"yes","job":"roof-inspection-drone"}.
